title.zh: 一个比特是一只会漏的电容：DRAM 刷新
title.en: A bit is a leaking capacitor: DRAM refresh

description.zh: 1T1C 单元靠电荷存一位，读是破坏性的，电荷几十毫秒就漏光；刷新每 3.9 微秒一次，tRFC 随芯片容量变长。按数据手册算刷新占掉的时间。
description.en: A 1T1C cell holds a bit as charge; reads are destructive and the charge leaks within tens of milliseconds. Refresh comes every 3.9 µs and tRFC grows with chip density; the share of time it takes, from datasheet figures.

title.en: Banks, rows, columns and address mapping

description.zh: 一颗 DDR5 芯片 32 个 bank、8 个 bank 组，每个 bank 65536 行；内存控制器把物理地址切成通道、子通道、bank 组、bank、行和列。
description.en: A DDR5 chip has 32 banks in 8 bank groups, 65,536 rows per bank; the memory controller splits a physical address into channel, subchannel, bank group, bank, row and column.

title.zh: 五个命令和时序：行命中、未命中、冲突
title.en: Five commands and their timings: row hit, miss and conflict

description.zh: ACT、RD、WR、PRE、REF 之间要等 tRCD、CL、tRP、tRAS、tRC；一个按周期走的模拟器比较开页和关页。
description.en: ACT, RD, WR, PRE and REF must wait tRCD, CL, tRP, tRAS and tRC; a cycle-by-cycle simulator compares open- and close-page policies.

en: row hit row miss row conflict

description.zh: CL 是周期数：纳秒数 = CL × 2000 ÷ 传输速率。DDR5-6400 CL32 和 DDR4-3200 CL16 都是 10 纳秒；标准档在 13 到 17 纳秒之间。
description.en: CL counts cycles: nanoseconds = CL × 2000 ÷ transfer rate. DDR5-6400 CL32 and DDR4-3200 CL16 are both 10 ns; JEDEC bins sit between 13 and 17 ns.

zh: 内存频率越高延迟越高吗
DDR5 延迟比 DDR4 高吗
en: does higher memory frequency mean higher latency

title.zh: 64 字节一次突发与 DDR5 子通道

description.zh: DDR5 用 BL16 和两个 32 位子通道，每次正好一个缓存行；实际带宽取决于行命中率和 bank 并行。
description.en: DDR5 uses BL16 and two 32-bit subchannels so each burst is one cache line; achieved bandwidth depends on row hits and bank parallelism.

description.zh: 同组两次读隔 tCCD_L，换组只隔 tCCD_S；DDR5-6400 下同组连读只能用一半的数据线。tRRD 与 tFAW 限制开行。
description.en: Two reads in one bank group are tCCD_L apart, across groups only tCCD_S; at DDR5-6400 same-group reads use half the data bus. tRRD and tFAW limit activations.

title.zh: 插几根：飞越式布线与训练
title.en: DIMMs per channel: fly-by routing and training

description.zh: 时钟和命令线一颗接一颗经过芯片，DDR5-6400 下芯片之间的到达差超过一个比特宽，必须开机训练；每通道两根内存条会降频。
description.en: Clock and command run past the chips one after another; at DDR5-6400 the arrival spread exceeds a bit time, so training is required, and two DIMMs per channel run slower.

zh: 内存条插四根为什么降频
插四根内存为什么降频

title.zh: 片上 ECC 和旁路 ECC

description.zh: DDR5 芯片里的 ECC 只修存坏的单个位、不报告；旁路 ECC 由内存控制器检查整条路径。汉明码的每种出错位置都枚举一遍。
description.en: DDR5's on-die ECC fixes single stored bit errors and does not report them; side-band ECC is checked by the memory controller over the whole path. Every error pattern of the Hamming codes is enumerated.

zh: DDR5 ECC 和 ECC 内存的区别
en: DDR5 on-die ECC vs ECC DIMM

description.zh: 线越短越快：LPDDR 焊在处理器旁，GDDR7 用 PAM3 一个符号送 1.5 比特，MRDIMM 用缓冲芯片让两个面交错。
description.en: Shorter wires go faster: LPDDR sits beside the processor, GDDR7 sends 1.5 bits per symbol with PAM3, MRDIMM interleaves two ranks through a buffer chip.

zh: 板载内存和内存条区别

title.en: Row hammer and its defences: TRR, RFM, PRAC

description.zh: 反复激活一行会让邻行漏电翻转；定向刷新会被多攻击行绕过，DDR5 的逐行激活计数（PRAC）按次数补刷。只数次数，不涉及攻击做法。
description.en: Activating one row over and over makes its neighbours flip; target row refresh can be overwhelmed by many aggressors, and DDR5's per-row activation counting (PRAC) refreshes by count. Counts only, no attack recipe.

title.zh: 内存的前沿（截至 2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: JESD79-5C 写到 DDR5-8800 并加入 PRAC；LPDDR6 标准已发布；MRDIMM 第二代在路上；DDR6 还没有发布的标准。
description.en: JESD79-5C reaches DDR5-8800 and adds PRAC; LPDDR6 is published; second-generation MRDIMM is on the way; DDR6 has no published standard yet.

title.zh: 看一根内存条时问三件事
title.en: Three questions to ask of a memory module

description.zh: CL 折成纳秒是多少；程序等的是延迟还是带宽；插几根、跑在什么速度上。
description.en: What CL is in nanoseconds; whether the program waits on latency or bandwidth; how many modules per channel and at what speed.
